model: YKHT Centrifugal Heat Pump Chiller, YT3 panel (SC-EQ)
equipment_type: Water-cooled centrifugal heat pump chiller (via SC-EQ card)
applies_to: YORK YKHT two-stage centrifugal heat pump chillers with the YT3 control panel, fitted with the SC-EQ communication card.
summary: The YKHT reaches a BAS through the SC-EQ communication card, which serves BACnet MS/TP (or Modbus RTU / N2). The BAS can start/stop the unit and write the leaving chilled liquid setpoint, current limit, hot water setpoint and a heating/cooling mode. Read-only points cover evaporator and condenser temperatures and pressures, low and high stage discharge temperatures and vane positions, motor, starter and VSD values, heating setpoints, cooling capacity and efficiency, control sources, and multistate operation, fault, warning, modified-run and start-inhibit codes with analog copies.
notes: Access is inferred: the sheet has no read/write column. The 'Write Data' block (AV 1-4, BV 1) is treated as commandable; everything else as read-only.

Status-code MVs (MV 1-4, MV 6, MV 7) use the Status Codes tables + 1, as the sheet says to add 1 for BACnet MSV values; the AV copies (AV 401-407) carry the raw code. Codes listed as N/A are left out.

MVs with their own enum in the points table (control sources MV 5, MV 8-11) are shown as printed, from 0; BACnet multistate values start at 1, so the card may report the printed number + 1. Confirm by discovery.
Several points apply only with an option: MVSSS starter values, VSD values, SSS input power, drop leg temperature, motor monitoring, heat recovery / hot water control.
Units shown are the IP units printed on the sheet; the sheet also lists SI units.
The sheet lists an Internal Fault Code table (SC.14) but no BACnet object uses it.

source.title: YT3 YKHT SC-EQ BAS Points List

integration.summary: Start and stop the unit with BV 1 and write the leaving chilled liquid setpoint (AV 1), current limit (AV 2) and, for heating, the hot water setpoint (AV 3) and mode (AV 4). Check the control-source points read BAS, then read MV 1 for the operating state, BV 5 for motor run, leaving water temperatures and % FLA, and MV 2 / MV 3 for safety and cycling shutdowns.
integration.enable: BV 1 REM RUN STOP CMD (0 = Stop, 1 = Run) is the BAS run/stop. MV 8 Run/Stop Control Source (Local, BAS, Hardwire) and MV 9-11 (cooling setpoint, heating setpoint and current limit sources) show where each command comes from; they should read BAS for BMS control. The sheet does not say how the sources are selected at the panel.
setup: The sheet notes that the remote write points report as unreliable until the BAS writes them.
gotchas: Write all of AV 1-4 once after commissioning; until then they read unreliable.
The MV status codes are offset by 1 from the printed codes; the AV copies are not.
Hot water setpoint and heating points only matter on heat pump or heat recovery with hot water control enabled.
